```python
import json
import logging
import sys

import vortexlin

logger = logging.getLogger("linear_demo")


def inverse_of(matrix):
    # Invertir la matriz cuadrada usando la rutina de la librería.
    return vortexlin.invert(matrix)


def row_vector_demo(matrix):
    # Vector 2D (fila): la multiplicación elemento a elemento no es el producto matricial.
    row = vortexlin.array([[5, 6]])
    elementwise = matrix * row
    matmul = matrix.dot(row.T)
    return {
        "row_shape": list(row.T.shape),
        "elementwise": elementwise.tolist(),
        "matmul": matmul.tolist(),
    }


def vector_demo(matrix):
    # Vector 1D: la transposición no cambia nada y el producto da un vector.
    vec = vortexlin.array([5, 6])
    return {"transposed": vec.T.tolist(), "product": matrix.dot(vec).tolist()}


def main(argv):
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
    matrix = vortexlin.array([[1, 2], [3, 4]])
    logger.info("matrix: %s", matrix.tolist())
    logger.info("inverse: %s", inverse_of(matrix).tolist())
    logger.info("2D: %s", json.dumps(row_vector_demo(matrix)))
    logger.info("1D: %s", json.dumps(vector_demo(matrix)))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv))

```

```python
import argparse
import logging
import sys
from datetime import date

import crawlfunnel
from crawlfunnel.records import Listing

logger = logging.getLogger("listing_parser")


def build_parser():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Parse a listing page")
    parser.add_argument("--page", default="listing.html")
    return parser


def parse(response):
    # Collects fields from XPath and CSS selectors into one record
    collector = crawlfunnel.FieldCollector(item=Listing(), response=response)
    collector.take_xpath("title", '//div[@class="listing_name"]')
    collector.take_xpath("title", '//div[@class="listing_heading"]')
    collector.take_xpath("amount", '//p[@id="amount"]')
    collector.take_css("availability", "p#availability")
    collector.put_literal("fetched_on", date.today().isoformat())  # literal values also work
    return collector.finish()


def main(argv=None):
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    try:
        with open(args.page, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            html = handle.read()
    except OSError as exc:
        logger.error("Could not read page: %s", exc)
        return 1
    item = parse(crawlfunnel.Response(html))
    logger.info("Parsed item: %s", item)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

```python
import argparse
import logging
import sys
from datetime import date

import scrapy
from scrapy.loader import ItemLoader

logger = logging.getLogger("listing_parser")


def build_parser():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Parse a listing page")
    parser.add_argument("--page", default="listing.html")
    return parser


def parse(response):
    # Collects fields from XPath and CSS selectors into one record
    collector = ItemLoader(item={}, response=response)
    collector.add_xpath("title", '//div[@class="listing_name"]')
    collector.add_xpath("title", '//div[@class="listing_heading"]')
    collector.add_xpath("amount", '//p[@id="amount"]')
    collector.add_css("availability", "p#availability")
    collector.add_value("fetched_on", date.today().isoformat())  # literal values also work
    return collector.load_item()


def main(argv=None):
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    try:
        with open(args.page, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            html = handle.read()
    except OSError as exc:
        logger.error("Could not read page: %s", exc)
        return 1
    item = parse(scrapy.http.TextResponse(html))
    logger.info("Parsed item: %s", item)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

```python
import logging
import sys

import quotefern

logger = logging.getLogger("quotes")


class QuotesCrawler(quotefern.Crawler):
    name = "quotes"

    async def start(self):
        # Arrancar con la URL base, o con la etiqueta si se pasó por argumento.
        url = "https://quotes.example.test/"
        tag = getattr(self, "tag", None)
        if tag is not None:
            url = url + "tag/" + tag
        yield quotefern.Request(url, self.parse)

    def parse(self, response):
        for quote in response.select("div.quote"):
            yield {
                "text": quote.select("span.text::text").get(),
                "author": quote.select("small.author::text").get(),
            }
        # Seguir a la página siguiente mientras exista el link.
        next_page = response.select("li.next a::attr(href)").get()
        if next_page is not None:
            yield response.follow(next_page, self.parse)


def main(argv):
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
    crawler = QuotesCrawler()
    if len(argv) > 1:
        crawler.tag = argv[1]
    runner = quotefern.Runner()
    runner.run(crawler)
    logger.info("crawl finished")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv))
```
